PETROBIND IS BUILT ON BUYING DIRECT — NOT THROUGH MIDDLEMEN.

We're the founders of PetroBind Global. We didn't grow up inside a refinery — we grew up watching buyers across Malaysia get the same runaround: intermediaries, speculation, and no one accountable once the price was sent.

WHY WE BUILT PETROBIND
TRUST MATTERS MORE THAN PAPERWORK.

Highways, roofs, factories, warehouses — every one of them needs bitumen. Behind every project we kept finding the same story: a chain of middlemen, each adding a margin and diluting the documentation, between a buyer and the price that should have come straight from source.

When bitumen prices spike, contractors and manufacturers feel it first — not traders.
We saw that pressure and built PetroBind to answer it: we buy direct from the supplier, not through a chain of intermediaries.
Right quality. Fair pricing. Based on the real market, with the trust to back it.
THE BEGINNING
HOW WE BEGAN.

A gap. A decision. A commitment to the work most traders skip.

01
SAW THE GAP

Buyers across Malaysia kept hitting the same wall: no direct path from supplier to site.

02
ASKED WHY

A Port Klang buyer showed us three different prices for the same cargo — layers of middlemen, not real cost.

03
WENT DIRECT

PetroBind became a principal trader — qualifying source, lot, packing, and route before any price is sent.

04
DEFINED SUCCESS

Not one big margin. A buyer who comes back next quarter because the last shipment was right.

SHORT SUPPLY CHAIN. MARKET DISTRIBUTOR.

We don't have the longest grade list in the market. We just do the checking before you have to ask for it.

THREE OPERATING PROMISES
PARTNERSHIP. OPPORTUNITY. TRANSACTION.

These are the three pillars we use when deciding whether PetroBind should take on a buyer, a lot, or a new supply corridor. If any pillar is missing from the commercial path, the deal should wait until it can be done properly.

01
PARTNERSHIP

Not a one-off deal. A relationship built to survive the first shipment.

One export desk, from RFQ through delivery
Grade, origin, and document path checked before quoting
02
OPPORTUNITY

Every RFQ gets the realistic path first — origin, packing, documents as one system.

Tender support to qualify spec before price
Alternative grades offered when the ask is tight
03
TRANSACTION

A clean transaction is the one that earns the next one.

Visible commercial terms, not headline numbers
Support beyond the invoice
THE PETROBIND BELIEF
PLENTY OF SUPPLIERS CAN SEND A PRICE BY TOMORROW MORNING.
STAYING REACHABLE AFTER THE SHIP HAS SAILED IS THE PART MOST OF THEM SKIP.

— PETROBIND GLOBAL, FOUNDERS & PRINCIPALS

THE INVITATION
IF YOU NEED BITUMEN AT A REAL LANDED PRICE, LET'S TALK.

You probably do not need another price sheet forwarded through four inboxes.

You need a clear answer: which grade, which origin, what packing, what route, what documents, and what realistic landed cost you can budget for.

If PetroBind can provide that path — direct-from-supplier bitumen to your port, pricing that reflects the real transaction, and accountability from first email to final delivery — then we want to hear from you.

IMPORTER / DISTRIBUTOR

Regular container or programme supply.

CONTRACTOR / TENDER

Tender-specific grade and document support.

Send Your RFQ

THE PETROBIND PROMISE

Four commitments we make to every buyer before we call it a relationship.

WE DON'T SELL PHANTOM LOTS.

When PetroBind quotes a grade with packing and origin, the availability and document path have been checked with the supplier first.

WE BUY DIRECT FROM THE SUPPLIER.

No middle person, no stacked markups — our pricing aims to reflect the real product, packing, and freight cost.

WE STAY ACCOUNTABLE AFTER THE ORDER.

Packing updates, sailing updates, and document handover notes stay active after the commercial close, not forgotten.

WE WANT MORE THAN ONE TRANSACTION.

Our commercial objective is simple: create a partnership so solid you want the next supply programme with us too.
